entities.summary:
Íñigo Vélez de Guevara, 7th Count of Oñate, played a pivotal role in shaping the Thirty Years' War.

Born in 1566, Salinillas de Buradón, Vélez de Guevara rose to prominence as a Spanish political figure, leveraging his influence to navigate the complex web of alliances and rivalries that defined this tumultuous era.

As a key player in the war, Vélez de Guevara's actions had significant consequences, both on the battlefield and in the realm of politics.

The legacy of Vélez de Guevara can be seen in the enduring impact of the Thirty Years' War on European history, with its far-reaching consequences continuing to shape international relations to this day.

One lasting statistic stands out: the devastating toll of the war, which resulted in an estimated 8 million deaths.
